The '''Tandun system''' was a young<ref name="Falcon" /> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Kalamith sector/Legends|Kalamith sector]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tandun III]]. The system was explored in [[12,293 BBY]] by a group of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] surveyors led by [[Doctor/Legends|Dr.]] [[Beramsh]]. In [[43 ABY]] Tandun III was destroyed as a result of [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Terraforming/Legends|Vongforming]].
